T-LOG 2026.08.10 [EN]

🌌 [2026-08-10 18:14]

[T-LOG: 2026-08-10 18:14]

Status: OPEN | Mode: SPOT.
In the zone 29820.0 - 29830.0, intensive volume exchange was recorded; a series of violent strikes against HVN barriers occurred, ending in a chaotic struggle for the support level. The NQ Probe oscillates at the level of 29825.50 (ADR: 37.55%), currently exhibiting a demand test (CVD: -1.02K). The NDX Star is in a sell-off phase (CVD: -48.63M), while the QQQ Satellite is executing a demand test (CVD: -253.61K). Background Radiation (TICKQ) is 93.00, which signifies accumulation, however, it remains below the SMA200 radiation average (134.85), which defines the current state as a market blast. Asset Average is [BRAK_DANYCH_W_TELEMETRII]. The Q-Score market vector is -10 (Probability: 45%), which, with IV at the level of 20.55%, indicates growing dissonance. I observe a stratification of the system: despite accumulation in the background radiation, key instruments (NDX, NQ, QQQ) exhibit negative CVD deltas and demand tests, suggesting that the growth structure is being sustained by low liquidity.
